tasks.title: Create the shared @chessboost/contracts package with typed Socket.IO events from events.md
tasks.dod: the package typechecks, a compile-time test covers every events.md event name, error code and GameSnapshot field, and both apps typecheck against it

tasks.title: Spike the deadline clock: TimeControl, Clock and the TimeSource port
tasks.dod: clock unit tests with a fake TimeSource pass for the increment (3+2 gives 3:02), the deadline boundary, the not-yet-running main clock and the 20 s / 60 s abort windows

tasks.title: Add the ChessRules port and its chess.js adapter
tasks.dod: adapter tests pass for illegal moves, promotion pieces, mate, stalemate, the en-passant-aware repetition key and the 50-move half-move clock

tasks.title: Build the Game aggregate: creation, half-moves, game-end precedence, material rules and time checks
tasks.dod: aggregate unit tests pass for every listed AC: turn switch, illegal-move no-op, promotion, mate, the four draw reasons with precedence, bishop colours, timeout win vs draw, abort, and refusal after the end

tasks.title: Add resign, cancel and draw offers to the Game aggregate
tasks.dod: aggregate unit tests pass for resign, cancel and the draw-offer rules incl. the blocked re-offer and simultaneous offers ending once

tasks.title: Write the Drizzle schema for the 5 game-play tables, generate the migration and diff it against the staged SQL
tasks.dod: drizzle-kit generates the live migration from schema.ts, its SQL matches the staged .up.sql (differences listed and resolved), and make migrate applies it on an empty database

tasks.title: Implement DrizzleGameRepository with one transaction per action, a version check and the command ledger
tasks.dod: integration tests on real PostgreSQL pass for round-trip, version conflict, duplicate commandId, one active game per player, release on end, and one open rematch offer per game

tasks.title: Build the per-game command queue and pipeline with MakeHalfMove and GetSnapshot
tasks.dod: application tests pass for strict per-game ordering, idempotent commandId, identical not-found for non-players, and the move-vs-deadline race decided by game time

tasks.title: Add TimerService: one timer per game, CheckTime, re-arm on boot and the 5 s safety sweep
tasks.dod: tests with fake scheduler and time pass for one Timeout per deadline, exactly one end after a simulated restart, the sweep catching a lost timer, the timeout draw by material, and abort on window expiry

tasks.title: Publish integration events after commit and create games from MatchCreated
tasks.dod: tests pass for game creation from MatchCreated with GameStarted after commit, GameNotStarted on an active game, isolated consumer failure, and GameEnded once and never for an abort

tasks.title: Add the in-memory PresenceRegistry that counts a player's tabs per game
tasks.dod: unit tests pass for multi-tab online counting, a single offline transition, reconnect and per-game isolation

tasks.title: Add the CurrentPerson port with the Cloudflare Access JWT adapter and a dev-only adapter
tasks.dod: adapter tests with a local key pair pass for a valid token and reject a bad signature, foreign audience, expired token and unknown email; the dev adapter refuses production

tasks.title: Build GameGateway: handshake identity, rooms, game:join, game:move, snapshots and presence
tasks.dod: socket integration tests pass for identical not-found, unauthenticated rejection, room-wide snapshot after a move incl. a second tab, unknown-field rejection, and the offline push

tasks.title: Wire resign, cancel and the draw actions end to end: use cases and gateway handlers
tasks.dod: socket integration tests pass for resign, draw by agreement, the blocked re-offer with retryAfter, simultaneous offers ending once, resign refused in the abort window, and cancel aborting

tasks.title: Wire the rematch end to end: offer, accept into a new game, close
tasks.dod: socket integration tests pass for one new swapped-colour game on agreement, double press as one offer, refusal while the offerer is offline, close, active-game refusal and no rematch after an abort

tasks.title: Bind game.module, re-arm timers on boot and add the temporary create-pairing CLI
tasks.dod: make arch is green, the server boots and re-arms timers, create-pairing produces a joinable game, and an overdue game ends exactly once on boot

tasks.title: Add the useGame composable: typed socket, snapshot state, local countdown, commandId and acks
tasks.dod: composable tests with a fake socket pass for snapshot state, active-side countdown, no emit while disconnected, pending on ack timeout and re-join on reconnect; web typecheck is green

tasks.dod: snapshotToView unit tests and page component tests pass for skeleton, rating-optional players, orientation, offline marker and the abort countdown

tasks.dod: component tests pass for rollback on rejection, promotion UCI, closing the picker emitting nothing, and one sound per new half-move

tasks.dod: component tests pass for Cancel-only in the abort window, confirmed resign, dialog cancel emitting nothing, each draw state and the blocked message

tasks.dod: component tests pass for every end-reason text, the aborted state, each rematch state, close-before-navigate on New game and the active-game message
